notes.title: Build 2021.1.30.1 - Audio Loop Fixes
notes.content:
We've been listening to feedback from you all and the soundtrack is causing issues with their loops. We hear you and don't want to break the game's immersion so we've taken some time to go back over all the loops in the game and updated each of the tracks to loops much more smoothly. 

Keep letting us know about issues with the game - we're listening and will fix what we can.
